question: Are there any outlier countries with unusually high CO2 per capita? (A) No, all points cluster near 5 t (B) Yes, a point near 38 t (C) Yes, a point near 10 t. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate scatter chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the data max, squashing the points into the bottom of the plot. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: B (Yes, a point near 38 t). Bait: A (No, all points cluster near 5 t).
